fact: PAMFP states that phase II of the SYDONIA customs software is to be implemented at Bata, Mongomo, Ebebiyin, Corisco, Aconibe, Cogo and Rio Campo, with IT equipment and network to extend SYDONIA outside Malabo.

UNCTAD ASYCUDA reports in June 2025 that ASYCUDAWorld is fully operational in all Equatorial Guinea customs offices, with Bata live since November 2024, the Malabo port since March 2025 and the Malabo airport since 2020, enabling paperless clearance.
The Prime Minister officially launched the Sidunea World customs platform at Bata customs on 27 December 2024; the finance minister says it has been in use at Malabo customs since 2021.
